reason: A DSH launcher plugin that generates a Windows startup script, optionally creates a desktop shortcut, checks and starts the local DSH web service, and opens it in a browser.

summaries.zh: 用于生成启动 DSH Web 界面的 Windows 脚本，可选创建桌面快捷方式、自定义图标并在服务就绪后打开浏览器。
summaries.en: Generates a Windows launcher for the DSH web interface with optional desktop shortcuts, custom icons, local service checks, and browser opening.

capabilities: Generates a Windows batch launcher script
Creates or updates a desktop shortcut through PowerShell
Checks a localhost DSH web endpoint with curl
Starts the DSH web service when unavailable
Opens the DSH address in the default browser
Registers a configuration namespace and a script-generation tool
